lessons_used: Predictions were consistently too optimistic for high forecasts, while zero or negative predictions underpredicted major wins.
Waiting screen info changes (home, wait_info) showed no clear effect across all 3 tests.
Sign-in hints (sign_in, hint) yielded mixed results, winning in 2 tests (+4.6% and +6.6%) but performing worse in 2 others (-4.6% and -5.5%).
Adoption redesigns (adoption, redesign) produced inconsistent results, winning in 3 tests (+6.1%, +4.7%, and +6.2%) while performing worse in 2 others (-4.4% and -9.3%).

Evidence remains thin for choose_path layout (1 win, 1 no clear effect), choose_path copy (1 win, 1 worse), and all single-test categories, as at least 2 agreeing tests are needed to establish a pattern.

lessons_next: Predictions remained biased: high positive forecasts consistently overpredicted impact, while zero or negative forecasts frequently underpredicted major wins.
Waiting screen info changes (home, wait_info) showed no clear effect across all 4 tests.
Adding new screens at the finish stage (finish, new_screen) consistently hurt performance across 2 agreeing tests (-16.0% and -9.1%).
Choose path copy changes (choose_path, copy) performed worse in 2 out of 3 tests (-3.0% and -3.7%), despite 1 winning test (+3.7%).
Adoption redesigns (adoption, redesign) and sign-in hints (sign_in, hint) yielded inconsistent results, each driving significant wins (+4.9% to +6.7%) alongside clear losses (-4.5% to -9.6%).
Evidence remains thin for categories lacking at least 2 agreeing tests (such as choose_path layout, finish layout, and single-test changes).
